summary: Formats one of three recorded time values on the postProcessInput object (dword_7C54E0) into the caller's output buffer. Computes the next circular index (current + 1, wrapping 2 -> 0), reads the float time at that index, and when it is positive decomposes it and formats it as " MM:SS.FFF" into the output buffer after copying the asc_5CCE18 prefix. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Compute the next circular index: v2 = *(dword_7C54E0 + 16448) + 1; the slot at offset 16448 holds the current index.
Wrap the index: if *(dword_7C54E0 + 16448) == 2 then v2 = 0, so v2 cycles over 0..2.
Initialize the output buffer: v3 = strcpy(a1, asc_5CCE18) copies the constant prefix string so v3 points at the start of the caller's buffer.
Read the time value for the selected index: v4 = *(float *)(dword_7C54E0 + 4 * v2 + 16552).
Only format when the time is positive: if (v4 > 0.0).
Decompose the time into its component fields for formatting: SpatialGridCell(time, &v6, &time).
Format into the output buffer: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v3, " %.2d:%06.3f", v6, time), where the format literal is a2d063f_1 (0x005CCE24).
